propositions: alert_store.is_deduped checks 24h suppression window via now - rec.get("timestamp_ns", 0) <= window_ns, but records built by BindingRepository.alert and other callers lack timestamp_ns, so ts defaults to 0 and the check always returns False

every pass over a corrupt bindings-retired.json appends duplicate binding-retired-file-corrupt records because dedup suppression never fires, causing unbounded local growth in the append-only alerts JSONL file
alert_store.append should centrally stamp timestamp_ns for all callers (when absent) rather than requiring each caller to supply it, making the documented dedup window actually functional

a caller-supplied timestamp_ns value must not be overwritten by central stamping to preserve byte-for-byte compatibility with existing stampers like apply_handlers.py, dispatch_apply_phases.py, and fetcher.py
